first.rationale: Activation is down 6% QoQ and onboarding completion down 4% QoQ. Memory_91 shows activation_messaging improved week-one engagement and first meaningful action—directly addressing the activation decline. Memory_86 confirms onboarding improvements are durable. Memory_31 reinforces that signup simplification works but is a separate lever. Promotional_pricing (memory_73) explicitly harmed 30-day retention and would be antithetical to sustainable revenue given the primary objective. Referral_incentive (memory_57) works but only on established customers—does not solve immediate activation gap. Enterprise_sales_assist (memory_44) is pipeline-quality focused, not activation-rate focused. Activation_messaging is the tightest fit: it targets the measured decline, has proven mechanism, and carries lower retention risk than promotional pricing. A standard experiment allows measurement of effect size before broader rollout. Verification of memory_86 and memory_91 will confirm magnitude and durability of prior lifts before commitment.
